problems.title: duration is a target leak
problems.action: Excluded from every model. Reintroduced only for the with-duration comparison run.

problems.title: pdays = 999 is a sentinel, not a number
problems.action: Split into binary was_contacted plus numeric pdays (999 replaced by -1, a placeholder outside the real 0–27 range; the flag carries the meaning).

problems.title: 'unknown' is missing data disguised as a category
problems.action: Kept as its own level (one of three defensible choices: keep / impute / drop). education=unknown subscribes above several known levels, so it carries signal.

problems.title: default is effectively constant
problems.action: Dropped the three-level column; kept a binary default_unknown flag.

metadata_discrepancy: UCI lists 'Has Missing Values? No'. Six columns contain the string 'unknown' — 12,718 cells in total. Technically true, practically misleading.

duplicates.note: Exact duplicate rows. Kept: 12 rows cannot move any metric measurably, and without client IDs we cannot tell a duplicate from two identical clients.

encodings.decision_tree: one-hot (fitted on train), no scaling needed
encodings.catboost: native categorical — ordered target statistics, no one-hot
encodings.tabnet: integer codes → learned embeddings (cat_idxs / cat_dims); numerics standardised
encodings.tabpfn: integer codes flagged as categorical; the model's own preprocessing
encodings.fp_growth: binned into items: age decades, campaign {1, 2–3, 4+}, macro terciles

split_protocol: Stratified 80/20 holdout (random_state=42). Stratified 5-fold CV on the training part only. All scaling, encoding vocabularies and class weighting are fitted inside each fold — never before the split.
